prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of change, as only one test has been completed for each category so far.
No effect was seen for adoption, redesign changes in the initial test.
Predictions were too high for adoption, redesign changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Photo Upload Guidance Stage: Inserts a pre-upload guideline screen that details lighting and angle tips for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported failed or distorted custom pet generations during adoption.)
1: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Render Progress Hub: Adds a secondary status screen during rendering to inform users that setup can continue in the background. (why: The waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while rendering.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet First-Meeting Spotlight: Redesigns home_intro with a spotlight layout emphasizing basic pet interactions like dragging, talking, and hiding. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or speak to the pet.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Screen Troubleshooting Callout: Adds a subtle troubleshooting hint below sign-in options to help users whose screen stalls. (why: Support logged 2 emails where the sign-in screen failed to appear or stalled.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Memory Badge: Adds a celebratory companion parent badge to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Quick Reassurance Copy: Updates headline and body copy on choose_path to clarify that path selection can be altered later. (why: Choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating user hesitation when picking a path.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Desktop Tray Notification Alert: Enables readiness notifications and clear time estimates on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting stage takes up to 2336s on average; clear notification hints reduce app abandonment.)
7: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Selection Stage Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with cheerful mascot elements. (why: Adoption drop-off is 39.1%, making it the main bottleneck in the onboarding funnel.)
8: [finish, notification] Onboarding Completion Welcome Notification: Adds an onboarding completed banner component on the final home_intro screen. (why: Helps transition users smoothly into active desktop usage after finishing onboarding.)

scores.note: Targeted pre-upload guidance screen addresses 3 support tickets at the adoption stage.
New status screen addresses extreme render wait times (mean 2336s) during home setup.
Redesign at finish stage; redesign changes previously showed minimal impact (+0.4%).
Simple hint addresses rare sign-in stalling reported in 2 support emails.
Badge incentive on adoption stage, which has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%).
Low-cost copy change to reassure users who hesitate (mean 514s) on path selection.
Tray notifications directly target long waiting stage abandonment (2336s mean).
Adoption stage redesign; previous adoption redesign yielded only +0.4% lift.
Welcome banner component on finish screen for post-onboarding transition.
